title: P2LRN Accessibility Profile
description: Describes accessible representations and relationships without duplicating the accessibility semantics of QTI, HTML/ARIA or source standards.
rules: Accessible alternatives SHOULD be modeled as representations of the same Resource when they are semantically equivalent.

Structured accessibility metadata MUST live in the representation extension keyed by https://p2lrn.org/profile/accessibility; representation.accessibility is the quick accessibilityFeature vocabulary view.
The structured metadata uses schema.org-style accessMode, accessModeSufficient, accessibilityFeature, accessibilityHazard, accessibilityControl, accessibilityAPI and accessibilitySummary fields.
P2LRN MUST preserve accessibility metadata supplied by an authoritative embedded profile such as QTI.
A consumer MAY prefer a representation role such as accessible for a user or deployment; Core does not force an accessible alternative globally.
The target for native web content is WCAG 2.2 AA, but metadata or P2LRN packaging alone does not certify conformance.
